content.rendered:
Enroll in the Cisco Free Data Science Course 2027 with Certificate on NetAcad. Complete the 6-hour beginner course and earn a verified digital badge!

New Delhi: Cisco, through its global education initiative Cisco Networking Academy (NetAcad), is offering the Introduction to Data Science course completely free of cost. Designed for beginners, college students, and aspiring tech professionals, this 6-hour self-paced program introduces core concepts in data analytics, big data storage, and machine learning while awarding a verifiable Cisco digital badge upon completion.

For Indian students and freshers looking to explore data-driven careers without paying expensive tuition fees, this Data Science FREE Course with Certificate provides a structured, beginner-friendly starting point. Learners can register online immediately and study at their own schedule.

About Cisco Networking Academy (NetAcad)

Cisco Networking Academy is one of the world’s longest-running IT skills-to-jobs education programs, backed by global networking and cybersecurity leader Cisco. Through its online learning portal (netacad.com), Cisco provides free, industry-aligned introductory courses in networking, cybersecurity, programming, and data science.

Earning a Cisco digital credential—issued and verified via Credly—gives students and job seekers credible proof of foundational knowledge that can be shared directly on LinkedIn profiles and resumes.

Free Data Science Course 2027: Key Highlights

Course Syllabus of Free Data Science Course 2027

The Introduction to Data Science curriculum is organized into 4 focused modules followed by a final exam:

  1. Module 1: Experience Analytics: Understand what data is, how data is generated everywhere in daily life, and how organizations use analytics for business understanding.
  2. Module 2: Data Collection and Storage: Learn the fundamentals of Big Data, data collection methods, validation, and how enterprises manage large-scale data storage.
  3. Module 3: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Separate AI fact from fiction and explore how Big Data powers modern Machine Learning applications.
  4. Module 4: Embarking on Your Career in Data Analytics: Discover career paths across Data Analytics, Data Engineering, and Data Science, along with actionable steps to prepare for entry-level roles.

Eligibility Criteria of Free Data Science Course 2027

Who Can Enroll?

  • Students & Freshers: High school students, college undergraduates, and graduates from any academic stream (Science, Engineering, Commerce, or Arts).
  • Career Switchers & Professionals: Beginners exploring data science, business intelligence, or AI/ML career tracks.
  • Technical Prerequisites: None. No prior coding, statistics, or data engineering background is required.

Official Requirements to Earn Your Certificate & Digital Badge

To unlock your official Cisco credential on the self-paced track, make sure you complete all four steps:

  • Verify Your Email & Profile: Complete your Cisco Networking Academy profile page and verify your registered email address.
  • Finish the End-of-Course Survey: Submit the mandatory feedback survey at the end of Module 4.
  • Score at Least 70% on the Final Exam: Pass the Introduction to Data Science Final Exam with a minimum score of 70%.
  • Claim via Credly: Once completed (allow up to 48 hours), accept your digital badge on Credly to download your printable certificate or share the verified badge link.

How to Enroll in the Free Data Science Course 2027 (Step-by-Step)

Follow these steps to register and start learning immediately:

  1. Visit the Official Course Page: Open the Cisco NetAcad Introduction to Data Science Course Page.
  2. Select Your Language & Click Get Started: Choose English (or your preferred language) and click the Get Started button.
  3. Create a Free NetAcad Account: Sign up using your email address or Google account and complete your learner profile.
  4. Complete Modules 1–4: Study the interactive lessons at your own pace (6 hours total).
  5. Pass the Final Exam & Claim Badge: Score 70% or higher on the final exam, submit the survey, and claim your verified Cisco badge.

1. Is the Cisco Introduction to Data Science course completely free?

Yes, the course is 100% free on Cisco Networking Academy (NetAcad) with no registration fee or hidden charges.

2. Do I get a certificate or badge after completing this Data Science course?

Yes. Learners who complete the end-of-course survey and score at least 70% on the final exam earn a verified Cisco digital badge via Credly along with a printable certificate.

3. How long does it take to complete the Cisco Data Science course?

The self-paced course takes approximately 6 hours to complete, allowing students to finish it over a weekend or at their own schedule.

4. Do I need prior coding experience to enroll?

No prior coding, math, or technical experience is required. This is an introductory beginner-level program open to students from all academic streams.

5. What topics are covered in the syllabus?

The 4-module syllabus covers Experience Analytics, Data Collection and Storage (Big Data), Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning basics, and Data Analytics career pathways.

6. Where can I register for this free Data Science course?

You can enroll directly on the official Cisco Networking Academy website (netacad.com) using a free learner account.
